metaDescription: Order custom 8 oz koozies for your next promotion. Perfect for slim cans and bottles. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom 8 oz koozies are designed to fit slim 8 oz cans and small bottles, making them ideal for energy drinks, sodas, or craft beer samples. Unlike standard koozies, this size offers a snug fit that keeps beverages colder longer without slipping. Choose from foam, neoprene, or stainless steel options, and add your logo via screen printing, embossing, or full-color wrap. Perfect for trade shows, employee gifts, or event giveaways where a compact, branded insulator stands out.
heroAltText: Custom 8 oz koozies in assorted colors with printed logos, perfect for promotional giveaways
